name: One&Only Royal Mirage Dubai
positioning: Dubai resort with an Arabian Court for families and an adults-only Residence, plus beach and garden villas with private pools
best_for: Families who want kids' clubs, a lagoon-style pool with a slide and interconnecting rooms
Couples looking for an adults-only enclave with its own pool

facts.text: The Residence has a dedicated pool, a Dining Room and a Library.
The Residence is minutes from Dubai's restaurants, bars and beach clubs.
The Arabian Court has a lagoon-style pool with a slide.
Guests can go out along the coastline on kayak, paddleboard and jet-pack adventures.
The resort has KidsOnly and One Tribe clubs for younger travellers.
The Arabian Court Deluxe Room has a king bed, sitting area and terrace, with desert-toned interiors and a marble bathroom.
The Prince Suite has a silk-canopy bed and a marble bath.
Spa treatments at the resort are by ESPA.
The spa has a sauna, steam and a swimming pool.
The Arabian Court Executive Suite features swirling Arabian-inspired patterns.
Guests in The Residence can play on the tennis courts.

highlights.text: Resident experts are on site for encounters with Saker falcons.
Nature drives over the dunes offer encounters with Arabian oryx, gazelle and camels.
The Prince Suite's terrace looks out over Palm Island Bay, Dubai Marina and the Gulf.
The Beach Villa has two master bedrooms, a private pool, dedicated hosts and a garden steps from the shore.
The Garden Villa has a private pool, two master bedrooms, personal hosts and a palm-fringed garden.

considerations.text: The Residence is reserved for adults.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the high-end positioning.
